decisionsTitle: The club places an order in a member's name: «Adaugă o comandă pentru un membru»
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-10:** the club had already collected a group order outside the site — a supplier's sheet: 27 people, 48 pieces, some already paid — and wanted the shop to track those orders too: who paid, who got theirs. Asked whether the shop should track them, he chose «Yes — «Adaugă o comandă pentru un membru»»: an Administrator places an order in a member's name, through the same locks and stock rules as the member's own «Comandă», audited, marked as placed by the club; the member sees it in «Comenzile mele» like any order; the people in the sheet need accounts on «Echipa» first — no free-text names, an order is a member account's record (§683).

**Decision.** A fold «Adaugă o comandă pentru un membru» / "Add an order for a member" at the top of the orders fold of «Magazin» (`/admin/shop`, its own section since §687), drawn for whoever may manage the shop and asserted at the action's door and again in the service — `canManageShop` asked of the actor, as every shop verb asks it, so a colleague holding «Gestionează magazinul» may press it whatever their role (BR-REQ-060-01): the member account from a select of every account whose role opens the members' zone (`listZoneAccountsForOrder`, the predicate `canOpenMembersZone` applied after the read, by name in Romanian order), the product and its variant as one choice («Tricou — M», or the product alone when its one variant has no label; a sold-out variant offered disabled with «— stoc epuizat», never a count; hidden products too — the sheet's items need not be on sale yet — never an archived one), one to five, a note, and two ticks. **The same core as the member's own order** (`orders.ts#insertOrder`): the product share-locked, then the variant locked, the repeat window read under that lock, the stock taken whole or the order refused (CONFLICT), the titles, the label, the unit price and the currency copied in the same insert — one sequence of locks, two doors into it, never a second copy. The row carries `placed_by = 'CLUB'` and `placed_by_staff_user_id` = the colleague's account (every earlier row is `MEMBER`), the member's name copied from the account and the order's language from the account's `preferred_locale`; audited `shop.order.placed_by_club` with the ids, the quantity and the two ticks — never a name, a note or an address. **The two ticks:** «Trimite-i membrului emailul de confirmare» queues «Comanda ta a fost primită» (`SHOP_ORDER_PLACED`) in the order's own transaction, and nothing without it; «Marchează direct ca plătită» moves the order to PAID in the same transaction through the one transition (`nextOrderStatus(PLACED, pay, CLUB)` by `moveOrder`, the writers' lock order, the row already held by the transaction that inserted it — never by writing PAID by hand), sets `paid_at`, audits `shop.order.paid`, and queues «Comanda ta e plătită» only together with the first tick. **The club's notice (`SHOP_ORDER_CLUB_NOTICE`) is never sent for a club-placed order**: the club does not email itself about its own press. A repeat of the same press within ten seconds — the same member, variant, quantity and note — answers with the order already placed, paid or not, as the member's own repeat does. The list marks the order «adăugată de club»; the CSV gains a column «Adăugată de» / "Placed by" after the member's name (and the address, for its readers) with «membru» / «club»; the member's view is unchanged — «Comenzile mele» lists it like any order and the member may cancel it while PLACED, the stock going back.

**Refused.** A free-text name: an order is a member's accounting record, and the account is what carries the address the emails go to and the language they read in — a person not on «Echipa» is added there first. A bulk import of the sheet: 27 rows are typed once by a person who checks each against the sheet, and a file upload would carry people's names through the repository's tooling. A separate «paid at once» status or a direct write of PAID: the one transition keeps «paid» one fact with one audit row, whoever reaches it. An email to the club for its own press. A client island for the fold: native selects, two checkboxes, the backoffice's `ActionForm` question and toast.

**Four currency nits of §686 closed on the way.** `parsePriceToMinor` also strips a leading «€» («€30», «€ 30,25»); `productFieldsSchema` refuses, on the price box, a word in it that contradicts «Moneda» («45 lei» with euro, «30 €» / «30 eur» / «30 euro» with lei — `currencyWordOf` reads the word for that one purpose and never to choose the currency); «Moneda»'s options are mapped from `SHOP_CURRENCIES` through a typed word lookup, so a third currency is a compile error in the editor; and the editor's product and order rows are rendered in a test with «12,34 €» and «24,68 €».

**Schema.** `shop_orders.placed_by` (`text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'MEMBER'`, CHECK `shop_orders_placed_by_known`) and `shop_orders.placed_by_staff_user_id` (`uuid`, `staff_users` `ON DELETE SET NULL`), one expand-only migration (`0136_shop_order_placed_by`, after §687's `0134_staff_user_permissions` and §686's `0135_shop_price_currency`). The audit action `shop.order.placed_by_club`. No new email type, no new dependency.

**Decided here, for the owner to overturn:** the fold places orders on hidden products too (the member's own door still refuses them); the privacy-notice gate of §683 is the zone's door and does not stop the club typing its own sheet; the member's email is off by default on the fold (the sheet was collected in person; the club decides whom to tell).

**Amends §683**: «an order is placed by the member from the zone» becomes «by the member from the zone, or by the club in the member's name through the same core — `placed_by` says which»; the orders list and the CSV gain the mark. `SETUP.md` §43 step 6 is the procedure.

**After §686 and §687 landed (the same day).** The branch was merged with the currency and the per-person grant as they shipped. Two consequences: the fold moved with the shop card to «Magazin» — the shop page reads the member accounts and the orderable items for whoever may manage the shop (`canManageShop(actor)`), the Organizer who only reads gets neither, and the fold's action answers on «Magazin» with the orders' filter kept (`backToShop`), never on «Membri»; and the door and the service ask `canManageShop` of the actor rather than of the role, so a volunteer given «Gestionează magazinul» places an order for a member and the same volunteer without it is refused on the server.
changelogLine: - **«Adaugă o comandă pentru un membru»** — on «Magazin», an Administrator, or the colleague given «Gestionează magazinul», types in an order the club collected outside the site, for a member account, through the same stock and locks as the member's own order, marked «adăugată de club» in the list and the CSV; the member's email only when ticked, and «Marchează direct ca plătită» for a row already paid. A price box may say «€30»; a word in it that contradicts «Moneda» is refused. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: An Administrator — or a colleague holding «Gestionează magazinul» — places an order in a member account's name through the member order's own locks and stock rule, marked `placed_by = CLUB` with the acting account, audited; the member's confirmation is sent only when asked; the club's notice never; an Organizer, a member, a volunteer without the grant, or an id that names no member account is refused on the server (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Marchează direct ca plătită» on a club-placed order moves it to PAID in the same transaction through the one transition — `paid_at` set, `shop.order.paid` audited beside `shop.order.placed_by_club` — and queues «Comanda ta e plătită» only together with the member's confirmation; a repeat of the same press within ten seconds answers with the order already placed (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Magazin» draws «Adaugă o comandă pentru un membru» with the member accounts for whoever may manage the shop — the grant's holder included — and gives the Organizer, who only reads it, neither the accounts nor the items (2026-10-10, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
